jpeg.description: JPEG texture decoding for scenes whose materialized assets reach image/jpeg

navigation.description: Recast/Detour navigation for scenes reaching navigation:recast — the overlay port pins isaac-mason's fork at the commit the pinned @recast-navigation/wasm builds, so navmesh, query and crowd behaviour matches the browser reference. Zlib-licensed, linked only where the scene's own source creates a navigation plugin.

physics.description: Bullet rigid-body solver for scenes reaching physics:world. Zlib-licensed, and linked only where the scene's own source creates a physics world.

ui.description: FreeType font rasterization for the optional RmlUi scene-created DOM projection.

ui-svg.description: LunaSVG inline icons for ui:inline-svg and the development RmlUi artifact.

webp.description: WebP texture decoding for scenes whose materialized assets reach image/webp
